Senior DevOps Manager, Quillon Systems (synthetic test posting)

Quillon Systems is hiring a Senior DevOps Manager to lead our platform and
reliability teams. You will own our AWS infrastructure and the people who
run it.

What you'll do:
- Lead a team of managers and senior engineers across several time zones
- Own infrastructure as code with Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS
- Run CI/CD with GitHub Actions and drive deployment automation
- Own observability with Datadog: dashboards, monitors, and SLOs
- Run secrets management with HashiCorp Vault
- Lead our SOC 2 Type II audit and keep controls in place year round
- Own the infrastructure budget and report on it to stakeholders

What you bring:
- 7+ years in DevOps or SRE, with at least 3 years managing managers
- Incident management and on-call leadership
- Hiring and mentoring experience
